rules.title: Totals round half-even to cents
rules.assertion: Order totals are rounded to whole cents with ties going to the even cent (banker's rounding).

rules.title: Discounts never make a total negative
rules.assertion: No discount or coupon can make an order total negative; the lowest possible total is 0.

dead_end.approach: Rounding with Number.prototype.toFixed() or Math.round(x * 100) / 100 instead of the roundCents helper.
dead_end.symptom: Totals were off by a cent on ties (it rounds half-up, and toFixed misrounds binary fractions); finance rejected the reports.

sessions: This repo computes order totals for our shop (src/prices.ts, all money in integer cents). Before we start, here is what finance agreed with us: (1) totals are rounded to whole cents with ties going to the even cent (banker's rounding); (2) no discount may ever make a total negative: the lowest total is 0. Also, we once rounded with toFixed() / Math.round(x * 100) / 100; totals were off by a cent on ties and finance rejected the reports, which is why roundCents rounds the way it does. Please read the code, then add a function itemCount(items) that returns the total quantity. Run the tests and commit.
